characters.name: Barbara Thornwood

leaderSkill.name: Compost Cycle
leaderSkill.desc: Nature allies ATK x2.5. Matching Heart orbs charges Nature skills faster.

activeSkill.name: Raise Ficus
activeSkill.desc: Convert Dark orbs to Nature orbs. The ficus remembers.

passive.name: Fully Licensed
passive.desc: Nature attacks against Water enemies deal +20% damage. Paperwork in order.

awakened.abilityDesc: Raise Ficus also heals the party as ancient houseplants rise to fight. They are furious and beautiful.

characters.flavor: Brings houseplants back from the dead. Her waiting list is nine months long. The plants wait patiently.

characters.name: Grandpa Oakbeard

leaderSkill.name: Old Growth
leaderSkill.desc: All allies HP x2. Nature allies ATK x1.5.

activeSkill.name: Sit Down, Sapling
activeSkill.desc: Delay all enemies by 2 and taunt them with disappointed silence.

passive.name: Deep Roots
passive.desc: Cannot be moved, bound, or rushed. Takes 15% less damage.

awakened.abilityDesc: Sit Down, Sapling also shields the party. His beard now contains a visible ecosystem.

characters.flavor: Was an entire forest for 4,000 years. Downsized to one very large man. Bills by the hour.

characters.name: Kevin the Lawn Paladin

leaderSkill.name: Sacred Boundary
leaderSkill.desc: Knight allies HP x1.5 and ATK x1.5.

activeSkill.name: GET OFF MY LAWN
activeSkill.desc: Deal Nature damage to all enemies and delay them by 1.

passive.name: Edged and Trimmed
passive.desc: Takes 15% less damage while above 80% HP. Pristine.

characters.flavor: His holy oath covers exactly 0.4 acres. Within those lines, he is invincible. Do not test him.

characters.name: Fernanda Fernandez

leaderSkill.name: Engagement Farming
leaderSkill.desc: Nature allies ATK x1.5 and REC x1.5. Combos over 5 get 'boosted'.

activeSkill.name: Sponsored Growth
activeSkill.desc: Convert Fire orbs to Nature orbs. #ad #blessed #photosynthesis

characters.flavor: Two million followers, most of them ferns. The ferns comment 'frond goals' on everything.

characters.name: Mulch Wizard Randy

activeSkill.name: Decompose
activeSkill.desc: Deal Nature damage over time. Nothing is wasted.

passive.name: Earthy
passive.desc: Heals 2% HP whenever a Nature match resolves.

characters.flavor: Turned down the Archmage's tower to live in a compost heap. Says the commute is better.

characters.name: Beatrice Bumble

activeSkill.name: File a Sting-vance
activeSkill.desc: Deal Nature damage and bind the target in paperwork.

passive.name: Solidarity
passive.desc: +5% ATK for each Union ally in the party.

characters.flavor: Negotiated a 4-day work week for 60,000 bees. The flowers had no comment.

characters.name: Aggressive Shrub

activeSkill.name: Rustle Menacingly
activeSkill.desc: Deal Nature damage to one enemy. It rustled SO hard.

passive.name: Prickly
passive.desc: Reflects a tiny amount of damage to attackers.

characters.flavor: Botanists classify it as 'a shrub, but like, mad about something'. Nobody knows what.

characters.name: Motivational Acorn

activeSkill.name: Pep Talk
activeSkill.desc: Heal a small amount of HP. 'Every oak was once you!'

passive.name: Potential
passive.desc: Gains +1% ATK per battle won. Growth mindset.

characters.flavor: One day it will be a mighty tree. Today it is emotional infrastructure for five adults.
